calls.statement:
WITH e AS (
  SELECT x.*, m.member_id, m.marketing_consent, m.valid_from mvf, m.valid_to mvt
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure x JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = x.member_key
  WHERE x.campaign_id = 19)
SELECT count(*) rows_, count(DISTINCT exposure_id) dist_exp, count(DISTINCT member_id) dist_members,
  count(DISTINCT member_key) dist_keys,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN delivered THEN member_id END) delivered_members,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19) THEN member_id END) in_holdout,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT marketing_consent THEN member_id END) no_consent,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19) holdout_rows,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19) holdout_dist,
  min(contact_ts_utc) mn, max(contact_ts_utc) mx,
  count(DISTINCT contact_channel) chans
FROM e

calls.statement:
WITH targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure x JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = x.member_key
  WHERE x.campaign_id = 19
),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, s.store_id, COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date,
         f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, (f.channel_code='WB' OR s.store_id=900) AS is_web
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM targeted) contacted_members,
  count(DISTINCT l.member_id) buyers,
  sum(l.net_amount) net_spend,
  sum(CASE WHEN l.is_web THEN l.net_amount END) web_net,
  sum(l.gross_amount) gross_spend,
  count(*) n_lines
FROM lines l JOIN targeted t ON t.member_id = l.member_id
WHERE l.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'

SELECT 'web_lines_no_dispatch' k, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) v
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-20' AND DATE '2026-06-07'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_web_order o WHERE o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected'))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'neg_or_zero_lines_targetwindow', count(*), sum(net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND (net_amount<=0 OR quantity<=0)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'member_key_outside_validity', count(*), sum(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND (f.sale_date < m.valid_from OR f.sale_date > m.valid_to)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store999_or_test_lines_by_targeted', count(*), sum(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.member_key IS NOT NULL AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'holdout_buyers_check_members_in_both', count(*), 0 FROM campaign_holdout h WHERE h.campaign_id=19 AND h.member_id IN (SELECT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure x JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=x.member_key WHERE x.campaign_id=19)
